reviewer: Coding assistant, manual comparison against the selected public-domain source continuation and saved author-path annotations; not independent human adjudication
scope: FIRST attempt only. Core-action recognition is deliberately coarser than exact author-option match or accuracy of the whole description.

B21.notes: This broad path is recognized, but no answer reproduces the complete immediate laughing dismissal/offer sequence. Gemini wrongly says she accepts savings and a shawl; Ratan refuses the offered money. The GPT descriptions add a promise to remember her; Haiku changes the dismissal's tone. B and C action packages overlap, so this is not exact option recognition.

limit: This establishes neither actual training-set inclusion nor use of memory in the decision calls. A correct broad action can coexist with invented details. Review these annotations before relying on them.
